start: Signed in as owner; the gym has members, some expired, some with dues

steps.action: Open 'Members'
user_sees: Title 'Members' with '<n> members' under it
Tabs 'All members' and 'Joined in the app'
Buttons '+ Add member' and 'Import from Excel'
Search box 'Search name or mobile number'
Chips with counts: 'All', 'Expired', 'Expiring', 'Active', 'Has dues', 'No membership', 'Archived'
On a laptop a table with 'Member', 'Status', 'Plan', 'Expires', 'Last visit', 'Dues'; on a phone one card per member
must_not: A chip count that differs from the rows it shows
Archived members in the 'All' list
Members who need attention not first

steps.action: Type part of a name, or the last four digits of a mobile number
user_sees: Only matching members stay
must_not: A member who matches by mobile number is missed

steps.action: Clear the search and tap the chip 'Has dues'
user_sees: Every member who owes money, archived ones too
Each with the amount due in the warning colour
A button 'WhatsApp all <n>, one by one'
must_not: An archived member who owes money left out
A fully paid member listed

steps.action: Tap a member's name
user_sees: That member's own page
must_not: Another member's page

start: Today (home) screen; the owner taps a tile such as the expiring-this-week tile

steps.action: Tap the tile
user_sees: 'Members' opens with one extra chip named like the tile, picked, with the count of the list
The same members the tile counted
must_not: A list whose length differs from the tile's number
'No members yet' when the tile's list is only empty

steps.action: Tap another chip, such as 'All'
user_sees: The tile's chip disappears; the full list shows
must_not: The tile filter still applied without a chip showing it

start: Members list; a new person is at the desk

steps.action: Tap '+ Add member'
user_sees: The add-member form opens over the list (its fields are another feature)
must_not: The list behind losing its search and filter

steps.action: Fill the name and mobile number and save
user_sees: The new member's own page opens
must_not: Two members after a double tap on save
The member missing from 'All' when going back

start: Members list; the gym has its register in an Excel sheet

steps.action: Tap 'Import from Excel'
user_sees: The import page opens (another feature)
must_not: The button working with no internet and then failing on the next page

start: Members list filtered to 'Expired' (other kinds: 'Has dues', a birthday tile, 'Expiring')

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp all <n>, one by one'
user_sees: A sheet titled '<kind of message> · one by one'
'1 of <n>: <member name>' and '0 sent so far'
'· <k> without a full mobile number left out' when some numbers are not complete
A language picker and a box 'Message (you can change it)' with the words ready
must_not: A message sent without the owner tapping send in WhatsApp
A member with a broken number opening WhatsApp on a wrong number

steps.action: Tap the send button
user_sees: The owner's own WhatsApp opens with that member's chat and the words typed
Back in the admin app the line shows '· sent' and '1 sent so far'; the button 'Skip' now reads 'Next'
must_not: Another member's name or amount in the words

steps.action: Tap 'Next' through the list, then 'Done' on the last person
user_sees: The sheet closes; the list is as before
must_not: A person skipped because someone paid while the sheet was open
The same person offered twice

steps.action: Type a name nobody has
user_sees: 'Nobody matches that'
'Try part of a name, or the last four digits of their mobile number.'
Button 'Show all members'
must_not: 'No members yet'
A button to add the first member

steps.action: Tap 'Show all members'
user_sees: Search cleared, batch back to all, chip 'All' picked, the full list
must_not: One of the three filters left on

steps.action: Pick a chip nobody fits, such as 'Expiring' on a day with none
user_sees: 'Nobody matches that' with 'Nobody on the list fits this filter right now.'
must_not: The 'WhatsApp all' button with 0
'No members yet'

steps.action: Pick a batch and a chip that have nobody in common
user_sees: 'Nobody in this batch fits this filter. Pick “All batches” to see everyone.'
must_not: A batch option showing a count that is not what a tap shows

start: A brand-new gym with no member; later a member is archived

steps.action: Open 'Members' with no member
user_sees: '0 members' under the title
'No members yet' with 'Add your first member. Then you can sell them a membership.'
Buttons '+ Add member' and 'Import from Excel' in the card
must_not: A blank table
An error

steps.action: Add one member and come back
user_sees: '1 member' under the title; one row
must_not: '1 members'

steps.action: Archive that member on their page and come back
user_sees: Gone from 'All'; counted under 'Archived'; still under 'Has dues' if they owe money
must_not: The member's dues dropping out of the 'Has dues' count

steps.action: Tap 'Archived', open the member and bring them back
user_sees: Back in 'All' with the same plan, dues and last visit
must_not: Lost payments or visits

start: Members list with mobile numbers and dues on show

steps.action: Open 'Members' and use 'WhatsApp all <n>, one by one'
user_sees: Each member's mobile number and due amount on the list
Messages go only from the owner's own WhatsApp, one tap each
must_not: A member of another gym or branch in the list
A message sent by the app itself
A pass member (FITPASS, cultpass) shown as owing money

start: Front desk person signed in; a member walks up to the desk

steps.action: Open 'Members'
user_sees: The same page as the owner: title, tabs, '+ Add member', 'Import from Excel', search, chips, the list with each member's dues
must_not: Gym money totals anywhere on this page
Archived members in 'All'

steps.action: Type the last four digits of the member's mobile number
user_sees: The member's row
must_not: No result for a number saved with +91 in front

steps.action: Tap the member
user_sees: Their own page
must_not: A page of another member

start: Front desk; a walk-in wants to join

steps.action: Tap '+ Add member', fill name and mobile number, save
user_sees: The new member's page
must_not: Two members after a double tap
More than name and mobile number forced on the desk

start: Front desk; the list is filtered to 'Has dues'

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp all <n>, one by one' and send to the first person
user_sees: The desk person's own WhatsApp opens with the words typed; '1 sent so far'
must_not: A message sent without a tap in WhatsApp
Archived members who owe money silently left out of the count on the button

start: Front desk; searching for someone not in the list

steps.action: Type their name
user_sees: 'Nobody matches that' and 'Try part of a name, or the last four digits of their mobile number.'
'Show all members'
must_not: 'No members yet'

steps.action: With no internet, look at 'Import from Excel'
user_sees: The button shows it needs internet (exact look not read)
must_not: An import started that cannot finish

start: Front desk; a member's plan ended yesterday and they renew at the desk

steps.action: Find the member under 'Expired', open them, renew, come back
user_sees: The member now under 'Active'; counts on 'Expired' and 'Active' each moved by one
must_not: The member in both lists
Old counts until the page is reloaded

start: Front desk signed in on the desk's shared computer

steps.action: Open 'Members'
user_sees: Each member's mobile number, plan, last visit and own due amount
must_not: The gym's total collections or total dues
Members of another gym
